Plug-and-perf (PnP) is `a widely used multi-stage hydraulic fracturing technique for horizontal wells` , involving pumping a composite bridge plug and perforating guns downhole on a wireline. The plug isolates the previous stage, and the casing is perforated to create new fracture pathways. This cycle repeats from toe to heel.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z-vCBV1AhBs&t=3)[[2]](https://accendoreliability.com/plug-perf-process/#:~:text=The%20Plug%20and%20Perf%20%28PnP%29%20process%20is,*%20Firing%20multiple%20clusters%20of%20perforating%20charges)[[3]](https://www.vigoroiltools.com/news/breaking-down-plug-and-perf-how-it-works-and-why-its-changing-the-game/)[[4]](https://www.slb.com/products-and-services/innovating-in-oil-and-gas/completions/well-completions/frac-plugs-and-sleeves/frac-plugs)[[5]](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/what-plug-perf-soo-tan)

**Key Aspects of Plug and Perf:** 

- **Process Flow:** A plug and perforating guns are pumped downhole. The plug is set to isolate the zone, then perforating guns fire to create holes for stimulation. The guns are removed, and the zone is fractured.
- **Flexibility & Control:** Offers high flexibility for stage spacing and placement, allowing operators to skip geohazards.
- **Efficiency:** Used in most unconventional, long-lateral horizontal wells in North America to increase productivity.
- **Components:** Utilizes wireline, perforating guns, ballistic setting tools, and frac plugs (composite or dissolvable).
- **Millout:** After stimulation, plugs are milled out using coiled tubing.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z-vCBV1AhBs&t=3)[[2]](https://www.slb.com/products-and-services/innovating-in-oil-and-gas/completions/well-completions/frac-plugs-and-sleeves/frac-plugs)[[3]](https://www.vigoroiltools.com/news/breaking-down-plug-and-perf-how-it-works-and-why-its-changing-the-game/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xyxtzq8ICtw&t=23)[[5]](https://www.bakerhughes.com/completions/multistage-completion-solutions/plug-and-perf-completions)[[6]](https://www.vertechs.com/news-detail/future-of-plug-and-perf-technology-in-the-oil-and-gas-industry-edge)[[7]](https://accendoreliability.com/plug-perf-process/#:~:text=The%20Plug%20and%20Perf%20%28PnP%29%20process%20is,*%20Firing%20multiple%20clusters%20of%20perforating%20charges)
